plan.insight: Each token scores every token by query-key dot product; softmax turns the scores into how much it attends to each.
plan.user_changes: click a token (or a matrix row) to pick the query, temperature, new embeddings
plan.reacts: attention links and weights, the full attention matrix, attention entropy

components.title: Attention from the query (click a token)
components.onClick:
if (part !== 'item') return null;
return { q: index };

components.title: Attention matrix (click a row)
components.draw:
const A = state.E.map((a) => softmax(state.E.map((b) => dot(a, b) / Math.sqrt(3)), state.temp).map((v) => round(v, 2)));
return [matrix(A, { id: 'A', heat: true, rowLabels: state.tokens, colLabels: state.tokens, highlightRows: [state.q] })];
components.onClick:
if (part !== 'cell') return null;
return { q: Math.floor(index / state.tokens.length) };

components.label: Entropy (bits)
components.value: return entropy(softmax(state.E.map((e) => dot(state.E[state.q], e) / Math.sqrt(3)), state.temp));
